findings.title: operator module name collided with forbidden capability import
findings.detail: WB-S3 first landed tools/workbuddy/operator_dry_run/operator.py; the name `operator` is in verify_public_safe_boundary.py's _MINIMUM_FORBIDDEN_IMPORTS, so `from . import operator` tripped BoundaryViolation in test_creative_public_safe_boundary.test_current_repository_passes_immutable_floor (a Codex acceptance oracle that scans the whole repo). Resolved by renaming the module to dry_run.py (commit 2c229eaa). All WB-V3b tests pass after the fix.

findings.title: Windows GBK subprocess decode noise in a Codex test
findings.detail: tests/test_creative_migration_confinement.py uses subprocess(..., text=True) without an encoding override; under the GBK code page this emits UnicodeDecodeError tracebacks to stderr. Tests still pass; it is cosmetic stderr noise, not a functional defect. Surfaces Codex-owned file; WorkBuddy did not patch it.

findings.title: ledger layer does not deduplicate repeated input
findings.detail: Re-submitting an identical payload records a distinct event (sequence increments, so event_hash differs). Idempotency (UC-IDEMPOTENCY) is not enforced at the ledger layer and must come from an upstream intake_dedup scope. Documented in tests, not changed.

findings.title: replay latency measurement required warmup + interleaving
findings.detail: Cold, sequential timing of CreativeLedger.replay() manufactured a 14.3x pseudo-superlinear growth for 1000->10000 events; after warmup + interleaved round-robin sampling the growth is ~10x (near-linear). WB-S1 receipts bake in warmup and interleaving.

known_risks: wall-clock replay/storage measurements are environment specific (shared local Windows machine); absolute values are not portable, only ratios and the near-linearity conclusion are.

the director-matrix corpus and operator scene vocabulary snapshot the checkpoint's registered scene/beat/fact values; a future checkpoint that adds or renames them requires re-deriving those constants.

WB-V1 identity verification is checkpoint-scoped (expected-head 7d8ac1f); after WorkBuddy advanced the branch it can no longer pass from the new HEAD and must be re-run on a fresh clone of the checkpoint ref.
